title: FedQoS: Federated QoS-Risk Learning for Heterogeneous Indoor-Outdoor Access Selection
abstract: arXiv:2608.25496v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable access selection in dynamic and heterogeneous indoor-outdoor environments is challenging because instantaneous radio measurements alone cannot capture future QoS degradation caused by mobility, blockage, traffic load, and resource competition. This paper proposes FedQoS, a federated QoS-risk learning framework for predicting the future reliability of candidate access links and supporting access-node selection without centralizing user-level network data. In FedQoS, each access node locally learns from its observed network logs, including radio, traffic, load, and service-context features, while a global QoS-risk predictor is trained through federated aggregation. The learned model estimates the probability of QoS failure for each candidate link, and the controller uses these risk scores to select reliable access nodes under dynamic network conditions. translated_title: FedQoS：面向异构室内外接入选择的联邦QoS风险学习
translated_abstract: 在动态且异构的室内外环境中，可靠的接入选择具有挑战性，因为仅凭瞬时无线测量无法捕捉由移动性、阻塞、流量负载和资源竞争导致的未来服务质量（QoS）退化。本文提出FedQoS，一种联邦QoS风险学习框架，用于预测候选接入链路的未来可靠性，并在不集中用户级网络数据的情况下支持接入节点选择。在FedQoS中，每个接入节点从自身观测的网络日志（包括无线、流量、负载和服务上下文特征）中本地学习，而全局QoS风险预测器通过联邦聚合进行训练。学习模型估计每个候选链路的QoS失败概率，控制器利用这些风险评分在动态网络条件下选择可靠的接入节点。为评估该框架，我们构建了基于物理的合成室内外环境。
tldr: 本文提出FedQoS框架，通过联邦学习在不集中用户数据的情况下预测候选接入链路的QoS失败风险，从而在动态异构室内外环境中实现可靠的接入节点选择。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FedQoS, a federated learning framework that predicts QoS failure risks for candidate access links without centralizing user data, enabling reliable access node selection in dynamic heterogeneous indoor-outdoor environments.
